name: Permutation Cycle Obfuscation
description: Replaces explicit algebraic composition rules with permutations of 8 elements. The bipartite 'opposite states' requirement is obfuscated by requiring the composed permutation to have an order of exactly 4, which only occurs when different permutations are composed. Composing identical permutations yields an order of 2. An LLM must correctly simulate or deduce the cycle structures of these specific permutations to discover the bipartite reduction, breaking simple static pattern matching.
